knownSourceDiscrepancies.detail: Markdown inventory K0-K12/thirteen lags machine manifest K0-K13/fourteen; K13 has a separate source contract; parallel source not modified.

facetPolicy: Facet applicability is resolved by exact functional role and family schema; absent mandatory facts are UNKNOWN. Registered fields alone confer no supported checker.

platformMappings.name: Project Model
platformMappings.contribution: Immutable adopted editions and self-contained snapshots; shared revision/command/freeze owner remains canonical

platformMappings.name: Electrical Topology
platformMappings.contribution: Typed terminals/ports, phase/neutral/PE semantics and internal connection capability; project topology supplies actual connections

platformMappings.name: Sources and Transformation
platformMappings.contribution: Transformer/generator/UPS/battery/BESS/PV-inverter/ATS variant ratings, impedance/source capability evidence, transfer/control interfaces; grid study is owner input, not fabricated SKU data

platformMappings.name: Loads and Demand
platformMappings.contribution: Rated power/current, power factor/efficiency domains, demand/operating-mode evidence; project profiles own diversity, priority and actual demand

platformMappings.name: Switchboards Panelboards MCC
platformMappings.contribution: Bus/incomer/outgoing capacity, N/PE terminal capability, pole arrangement, kits and exact physical definitions; ELV6 owns placements

platformMappings.name: Cables Conductors Containment
platformMappings.contribution: Material, insulation, cross-section, loaded conductor basis, N/PE/PEN, resistance/thermal data, installation-domain references; no unverified ampacity from a marketing string

platformMappings.name: Core Electrical Calculations
platformMappings.contribution: Dimensioned, condition-bound parameter evidence for accepted electrical kernels; no formulas hidden in SKUs

platformMappings.name: Protection and Coordination
platformMappings.contribution: B/C/D and typed residual/fuse classes, complete release/TCC/energy and coordination evidence, exact pair/conditions

platformMappings.name: Motors and Drives
platformMappings.contribution: Motor/load curves, startup modes, duty, VFD/soft-starter settings and compatible starter/overload accessories; electrical owner calculates start/fault effects

platformMappings.name: Earthing Bonding SPD
platformMappings.contribution: PE/PEN terminal, bonding and SPD type/system/impulse/interface evidence; actual earthing arrangement and electrode tests are project facts

platformMappings.name: Lighting and Small Power
platformMappings.contribution: Luminaires, drivers, sockets, switches, multi-gang compatibility, emergency supply interfaces and physical footprints; no inferred lux coverage

platformMappings.name: ELV CCTV LAN ACS FIRE
platformMappings.contribution: CCTV/LAN/ACS/FIRE typed facets and exact power/media/mounting/accessory compatibility, shared with existing ELV2–ELV5 identities

platformMappings.name: Operating Scenarios
platformMappings.contribution: Product operating-domain envelopes, ATS timing/interlock capability and source/control failure behavior; versioned project scenario engine owns execution

platformMappings.name: Reliability and Failure Analysis
platformMappings.contribution: Redundancy interface/independence constraints and provenance-qualified reliability data when available; no invented MTBF or uptime from a brand

platformMappings.name: Normative Validation
platformMappings.contribution: Exact standards/product declaration references and applicability context; ELV7 verifies rules/claims

platformMappings.name: Equipment Selection
platformMappings.contribution: Candidate technical/physical/offer snapshots; AUTO_SELECTED / USER_SELECTED / USER_OVERRIDE reason, alternatives and explainable eligibility

platformMappings.name: Single Line Diagram
platformMappings.contribution: Versioned symbol/terminal/rating bindings; diagram is a project topology view, not catalogue connectivity truth

platformMappings.name: Automatic Project Audit
platformMappings.contribution: Missing/untrusted/stale/obsolete/revoked/counterfeit-suspect identity findings; remediation candidates, never silent auto-fix

platformMappings.name: Professional Deliverables
platformMappings.contribution: Equipment descriptions, quantities/units, accessories, installation pricing and selected snapshots for BOM/schedules/dossier; source model owns takeoff

platformMappings.name: Collaboration and Sharing
platformMappings.contribution: Embed exact selected technical/evidence closure in immutable shared revisions; exclude private supplier terms and restricted files under explicit export policy

platformMappings.name: Field Verification and Commissioning
platformMappings.contribution: Compare installed manufacturer/variant/serial evidence to designed edition, track inspection/test references; inspection records never mutate catalogue definitions

killerMappings.name: Automatic Switchboard Synthesis
killerMappings.contribution: Whole board variant incl. incomer/bus/N/PE/protection/accessories/reserve, phase policy and verified ELV6 fit; finalized circuit requirements first

killerMappings.name: Project Autopilot
killerMappings.contribution: Requirement-driven architecture candidates with explicit source/asset needs; no SKU-driven topology mutation; actual topology/scenario kernels remain prerequisites

killerMappings.name: Engineering Audit + Auto-Fix
killerMappings.contribution: Alternative technical editions/kits, dependency impact and complete validation before reviewed apply

killerMappings.name: Failure X-Ray
killerMappings.contribution: Control/power dependencies of supplies/gateways/accessories exposed to failure owner; no failure propagation invented by catalogue

killerMappings.name: Revision Impact Intelligence
killerMappings.contribution: Differentiate technical, geometry, source-trust, compatibility and offer changes with affected scope and preserved historic selections

killerMappings.name: Multi-Objective Design Optimizer
killerMappings.contribution: Explicit objective vectors and Pareto frontier for comparable proven-feasible alternatives; weights/units and dominance semantics visible; no false global optimum

killerMappings.name: Critical Power Simulator
killerMappings.contribution: Exact normal/emergency/source-transfer operating capability and setting editions; electrical state and time simulation remains owner-produced

killerMappings.name: As-Built / Commissioning Twin
killerMappings.contribution: Designed/installed/verified/commissioned evidence separate; same-looking vendor label does not prove equivalent rating or installed identity

killerMappings.name: Vendor-Neutral Equipment Optimizer
killerMappings.contribution: Requirements before products; strict eligible set then complete cost/ranking; optional brand policy never weakens physical/normative facts

killerMappings.name: Company Engineering Rules
killerMappings.contribution: Versioned project/company overlays, preferred patterns and allowlists; no edits to vendor edition or override of mandatory law

killerMappings.name: Brownfield Reconstruction
killerMappings.contribution: Preserve UNKNOWN/INFERRED/OBSERVED/VERIFIED identity and parameter evidence; partial nameplate/OCR is a candidate, not an authoritative product mapping

killerMappings.name: Explainable Engineering Copilot
killerMappings.contribution: Read-only grounded lookup/explanation and proposed commands tied to edition/source; AI-generated product facts never enter approved data without validation

killerMappings.name: Smart Room Electrical Layout
killerMappings.contribution: Family-specific footprint, mounting surface, allowed orientations, physical grouping, switch/socket compatibility and supply/control interfaces; room/door/window/guide coordinates remain geometry-owner facts

killerMappings.name: Smart Building & Home Automation Designer
killerMappings.contribution: Protocol-agnostic sensor/actuator/controller capabilities, distinct protocol/transport and power/control/communication dependencies; design and commissioning data only

smartBuildingMappings.name: Automation topology
smartBuildingMappings.contribution: Controller/gateway/sensor/actuator roles, compatible port/segment schema, bus supply demand and declared channel capacities

smartBuildingMappings.name: Electrical-load binding
smartBuildingMappings.contribution: Real electrical load refs, actuator contact/dimming/starting-load domain and separately versioned control capability; no double-counted smart-device load

smartBuildingMappings.name: Lighting automation / DALI
smartBuildingMappings.contribution: Exact DALI family/capabilities, control gear/device distinction, bus power/address/group capacity and evidence; no global hard-coded bus limits

smartBuildingMappings.name: KNX engineering
smartBuildingMappings.contribution: Exact transport/interface, supply/line/coupler demand/capability, typed addressing profile; no automatic equivalence of Classic/IP/Secure/IoT

smartBuildingMappings.name: Matter / Thread / Zigbee / Z-Wave / Wi-Fi / PLC-IoT
smartBuildingMappings.contribution: Separate protocol and transport editions, regional radio applicability, frequency/power/product variant and gateway/bridge dependencies; Matter is not equated to Thread

smartBuildingMappings.name: Scenes and control logic
smartBuildingMappings.contribution: Supported control-point types/ranges, command/fallback/manual-override capability; project scenes and priorities belong to automation owner

smartBuildingMappings.name: Automation failure simulation
smartBuildingMappings.contribution: Distinct electrical, control and communication availability; gateway/cloud/local dependencies explicit, unknown fallback not assumed

smartBuildingMappings.name: Smart Room Wizard
smartBuildingMappings.contribution: Room-role matching to typed sensors/actuators/control bindings and complete accessory power/space demand; candidates before mutation

smartBuildingMappings.name: Control / I-O matrices
smartBuildingMappings.contribution: Channel, sensor/actuator/control-point and terminal definitions for I/O/KNX/DALI/commissioning schedules

smartBuildingMappings.name: Automation Audit
smartBuildingMappings.contribution: Missing address/channel/gateway/fallback/security/commissioning facts become visible obligations; life-safety overrides comfort policy
